en: This is a sepia-toned postcard featuring the ornate interior courtyard of a traditional Moroccan palace or mansion. The image showcases detailed geometric tilework, horseshoe arches, and intricate plasterwork. There is a large, decorative fountain on the left side and open windows with shutters. The architectural style is distinctly Moroccan, with heavy Moorish and Islamic influences.
